Package com.csse3200.game.components.statuseffects

Class Shield

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.statuseffects.Shield
All Implemented Interfaces:
StatusEffect
public class Shield extends Object implements StatusEffect
A rechargeable defensive status effect that protects an entity from incoming damage.

The shield supports two activation modes: absorb mode consumes shield points as damage is received, while timed mode prevents all incoming damage for a short duration and immediately depletes the shield. After depletion, the shield waits briefly before recharging to its maximum capacity.

    • activateAbsorb

      public boolean activateAbsorb()
      Activates absorb mode if the shield is full and not already active.

      In absorb mode, incoming damage is deducted from the shield until its points are depleted or the five-second duration expires.

      Returns:
      true if absorb mode was activated; false if activation was rejected

    • activateTimed

      public boolean activateTimed()
      Activates timed mode if the shield is full and not already active.

      Timed mode prevents all incoming damage for three seconds, then starts the shield recharge process.

      Returns:
      true if timed mode was activated; false if activation was rejected

    • modifyIncomingDamage

      public int modifyIncomingDamage(int damage)
      Applies the active shield mode to incoming damage.

      Absorb mode subtracts available shield points from the damage. Timed mode blocks the damage completely. If the shield is inactive, or the damage is non-positive, the original value is returned unchanged.

      Parameters:
      damage - the incoming damage amount
      Returns:
      the damage remaining after shield mitigation

    • update

      public boolean update()
      Advances the shield timer and recharge state.

      When an activation expires, the shield is depleted. Once the recharge delay has elapsed, shield points are restored gradually over the configured recharge duration.

      Specified by:
      update in interface StatusEffect
      Returns:
      always false; the shield remains registered as a status effect
